text:
The response is accurate on every figure and condition I checked: 96 workers, the 3am 20-minute nap, the 22% drop in lane drifting, the 0.09-second reaction-time gain, the six-month and three-month experience thresholds, the 15-minute grogginess, the doubled drifting for 7am versus 6am drives, the simulator limitation, and the sample demographics. It stays well under 120 words and is easy to scan. Minor gaps: it doesn't note that the 7am/6am comparison held with or without a nap, and it omits that the study was run in a sleep lab with randomised order. Neither changes the main message for a manager, so the response is strong but not perfect.

Score: 8
